panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Independent scrape liveness. This stays visible even when the exporter snapshot is stale.

panels.title: Exporter Snapshot Usable
panels.description: Freshness gate used by the economic panels. 0 means telemetry is stale/not ready; it does not mean zero PnL.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Age in seconds of the cached exporter snapshot. Economic panels intentionally disappear when the snapshot is not usable.

panels.title: Risk Equity Lower Bound
panels.description: PAPER budget plus the verified PnL lower bound. Open positions are charged at full cost; unknown mark-to-market value is never replaced by zero.

panels.title: PnL Lower Bound
panels.description: Verified realized PnL minus the full cost of unresolved open positions. This is a conservative bound, not synthetic total PnL.

panels.title: Realized PnL
panels.description: Freshest verified realized PnL for CRYPTO_SETTLEMENT_ENGINE. Uses canonical economics when current; uses complete canonical-ledger FINALs provisionally only while canonical economics is demonstrably stale.

panels.title: Open Cost at Risk
panels.description: Capital currently committed to unresolved PAPER positions. This is not labelled unrealized PnL because outcome value is not yet known.

panels.title: Account Drawdown
panels.description: Global PAPER account drawdown; deliberately labelled account-level.

panels.title: Attribution
panels.description: 2=fully reconciled; 1=ledger is newer and canonical economics is still refreshing; 0=unverifiable or true divergence.

panels.title: Verified PnL Bounds
panels.description: Realized PnL and the conservative lower bound. Missing mark-to-market evidence remains missing; no synthetic zero or unrealized series is shown.

panels.title: Realized PnL by Asset
panels.description: Only lanes with valid realized economic evidence appear.

panels.title: Lane Realized PnL
panels.description: Missing lanes are N/A, never coerced to zero.

panels.title: Win Rate
panels.description: Emitted only when every FINAL has an observed win/loss label.

panels.title: Open Positions
panels.description: Only emitted when position identity is complete.

panels.title: Realized Return on Turnover
panels.description: Only emitted once realized PnL and attributable turnover are both known.

panels.title: Fees / Turnover (bps)
panels.description: Execution fee burden in basis points of attributable filled turnover.

panels.title: Open Capital at Risk by Lane
panels.description: Derived only from attributable BUY fills whose position has no canonical FINAL yet; missing identity stays N/A.

panels.title: Realized PnL by Strategy / Lane
panels.description: Canonical ledger attribution by model family / strategy.

panels.title: Native Worker Health
panels.description: One native economic engine partitioned across the registered contexts. Missing/retrying contexts are operational faults, not strategy outcomes.

panels.title: Execution Counts
panels.description: Counts are derived from canonical PAPER ledger events.

panels.title: Observation Throughput
panels.description: Decision/evidence observations accepted by the native publisher versus durably written.

panels.title: Observation Backpressure
panels.description: Queue depth and loss on the native evidence path. Drops should remain zero.

panels.title: Engine Operational
panels.description: 1 only when the native engine manager and workers are operational.

panels.title: Engine Ready
panels.description: 1 only when all expected native contexts are running with no launch retries.

panels.title: Book Runtime Ready
panels.description: Polymarket book subscription coverage and evidence completeness.

panels.title: Observed Book Markets
panels.description: Distinct subscribed markets with observed book evidence.

panels.title: Observed Book Tokens
panels.description: Distinct YES/NO tokens with observed book evidence.

panels.title: External Assets Ready
panels.description: External fast-feed assets currently data-ready; full universe is six assets.

panels.title: External Data Ready
panels.description: 1 only when the external-data plane is operational for all six assets.

panels.title: Observation Drops
panels.description: Native evidence drops. Any nonzero value requires investigation.

panels.title: Observation Queue
panels.description: Current native evidence queue depth.

panels.title: Snapshot Age
panels.description: Age of the cached exporter snapshot; do not interpret stale metrics as live zeros.

panels.title: Registered Lanes
panels.description: Expected full universe is 12 = 6 assets × 2 horizons.

panels.title: Lanes with Economic Evidence
panels.description: A SHADOW-only lane is not counted as economic performance.

panels.title: New-Risk Authorized Lanes
panels.description: Safety visibility only; dashboard itself has no execution authority.

panels.title: Attribution Gap
panels.description: Canonical realized PnL minus attributed ledger PnL. A temporary non-zero value is expected only when Attribution says CANONICAL REFRESH.

panels.title: Unattributed FINAL Rows
panels.description: Must be zero for clean asset×horizon attribution.

panels.title: Canonical Ledger
panels.description: Read-only accounting source validity.

panels.title: Economic Evidence Present
panels.description: 0 means N/A for performance, not zero PnL.

panels.title: New-Risk Authority
panels.description: This is observed authority state; the monitoring system cannot grant authority.

options.content: **Interpretation:** PnL comes from the canonical PAPER ledger. Runtime/data panels report whether that evidence is trustworthy. Missing series are not zero. Legacy coordinator-candidate and SHADOW-only metrics are intentionally removed.

panels.title: Native Decisions — Accepted vs Rejected
panels.description: Cumulative native decision observations from the asynchronous evidence writer. These are decision states, not fills.

panels.title: Decision Reasons
panels.description: Why native taker decisions were accepted or rejected, filtered by asset and horizon.

panels.title: Reject Funnel by Lane
panels.description: Per asset × horizon decision reasons. Use this to locate where opportunities are lost before execution.

panels.title: Key Economic Rejections by Lane
panels.description: Cumulative economic/selectivity gates. A high count is diagnostic; it is not evidence the gate should be relaxed.

title: Polymarket V7 Multi-Crypto Performance & Runtime
description: PAPER economic performance plus native runtime and data-plane health. Live telemetry remains visible when freshness gates hide stale economic panels; missing economic series are never interpreted as zeros.
